name: Earnings Beat vs Miss: 30-Day Forward Returns
description: Compares 30-day forward returns after earnings beats (EPS Surprise % > 0) vs misses (EPS Surprise % <= 0) for AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, and GOOGL. Includes per-asset boxplots, cross-sectional bar chart of average returns, summary statistics table, and event markers on each earnings date.
source:
# --- Earnings Beat vs Miss: 30-Day Forward Returns ---
# Compares post-earnings drift for AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL
# Beat = EPS Surprise % > 0; Miss = EPS Surprise % <= 0

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()()
earn = earnings()
ts = index().value

# Forward 30-day return from each bar
fwd_30d = forward_returns(src.c, 30, return_type=ReturnsType.simple)

# --- Earnings Event Detection ---
is_earnings = is_valid(earn.actual_eps)
eps_surp = earn.eps_surprise_percent

# Beat vs Miss classification
is_beat = eps_surp > 0
is_miss = eps_surp <= 0
beat_miss_label = conditional_select(is_beat, "Beat", "Miss")

# Filter forward returns to earnings dates only
fwd_at_earnings = where(is_earnings, fwd_30d)

# Separate beat and miss forward returns
beat_fwd = where(is_earnings and is_beat, fwd_30d)
miss_fwd = where(is_earnings and is_miss, fwd_30d)

# Beat hit rate: positive forward return after a beat
beat_positive = where(is_earnings and is_beat and fwd_30d > 0, fwd_30d)
# Miss hit rate: positive forward return after a miss
miss_positive = where(is_earnings and is_miss and fwd_30d > 0, fwd_30d)

# --- Event Markers ---
# Show Beat/Miss badge, EPS surprise %, and 30d forward return on each earnings date
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Earnings Event',
        icon=Icon.BarChart2Icon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Result', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='EPS Surprise %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='30d Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(beat_miss_label, eps_surp, fwd_30d, is_earnings)

# --- CHART 1: Boxplot per asset (grouped by Beat/Miss) ---
# Shows distribution of 30-day forward returns split by earnings outcome
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='Do Earnings Beats Lead to Better 30-Day Returns?',
    x_axis_label='Earnings Outcome',
    y_axis_label='30-Day Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='Earnings Analysis',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    outlier_color=Color.Blue,
    order=1
)(values=fwd_at_earnings, label=where(is_earnings, beat_miss_label))

# --- CHART 2: CS Bar Chart (avg 30d return, Beat vs Miss per asset) ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.grouped,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Average 30-Day Return: Beats vs Misses',
    x_axis_label='Asset',
    y_axis_label='Avg 30-Day Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series_names=['Beat', 'Miss'],
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Gray],
    data_labels=True,
    category='Earnings Analysis',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(beat_fwd, miss_fwd))

# --- TABLE: Cross-sectional summary statistics ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Earnings Reaction Summary',
    category='Earnings Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    order=0,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Earnings Reaction Summary',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg 30d (Beat)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg 30d (Miss)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Med 30d (Beat)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Median),
            ColumnSpec(title='Med 30d (Miss)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Median),
            ColumnSpec(title='Beat Hit Rate', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Miss Hit Rate', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='# Beats', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title='# Misses', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                       grid_agg=AggregationType.Count)
        ]
    )
)(beat_fwd, miss_fwd, beat_fwd, miss_fwd, beat_positive, miss_positive, beat_fwd, miss_fwd)
